133.Name: Filthmonger's Cursebinder
133.Description: "The School of the Dead's library houses unfathomable forbidden knowledge. It does not lack for magic spells entirely unknown to man." - The Wraithlands

134.Name: Bleak Claws
134.Description: "Were we to exchange places, you would surely understand our burning hatred." - The Bleakest Lament

135.Name: Wraith's Severance
135.Description: "The Executioner of Bantus had no concept of mercy. Without hesitation, he put every rebel to death." - A Brief History of the Wasteland

136.Name: Filthmonger's Coronet
136.Description: "Horrifying screams reverberate throughout the land, as though mocking the bones buried there." - The Wraithlands

137.Name: Bleak Mask
137.Description: "Death completely changed us, and so we hide in the shadows." - The Bleakest Lament

138.Name: Wraith's Casque
138.Description: "He commanded the dead armies to return, seizing King's Manse, giving this once domineering realm a whole new character." - A Brief History of the Wasteland

139.Name: Filthmonger's Raiment
139.Description: "The odor of death rises into the atmosphere, permeating the sky, deterring all living beings who would from stepping foot in such a place." - The Wraithlands

140.Name: Bleak Robes
140.Description: "Hatred... It is both our poison, and our remedy." - The Bleakest Lament

141.Name: Wraith's Cuirass
141.Description: "In the Bantus Wasteland, the screams of the dead echo through every street and ally, clusters of white bones decorating the walls of Bantus." - A Brief History of the Wasteland

142.Name: Filthmonger's Stompers
142.Description: "There are no living mourners to grieve at these graves, only the solitary nameless souls that roam the land." - The Wraithlands

143.Name: Bleak Tramplers
143.Description: "Roaming amidst the unkempt graves, we lose ourselves, and dissolve into shadow." - The Bleakest Lament

144.Name: Wraith's Sabatons
144.Description: "Trampled by the weight of iron, those mortals who refused to submit were flattened by the legions of dead." - A Brief History of the Wasteland

145.Name: Witchdoctor's Prayers
145.Description: "The Spirit of Nature showed compassion, nurturing us. She made waters flow in parched lands, made blossoms open in the desert sands." - The Carved Annals of Plenty

146.Name: Berserker's Assaulters
146.Description: "To be a hunter, one must embody brutality. Targeting your prey's weak point with maximum efficiency means ensuring there is no escape, even for the fiercest quarry." - Hunter's Creed

147.Name: Wild-blood Gladiators
147.Description: "Ferality keeps us present in combat. Killing proves our strength, the best test of might. Only the strongest will be revered!" - Blood Guard Oath

148.Name: Witchdoctor's Coronet
148.Description: "With the Spirit of Nature's blessing, we will remove the blinders placed on our eyes and see the world with clarity. But do remember, do not pry into the mysteries of life." - The Carved Annals of Plenty

149.Name: Berserker's Ambush
149.Description: "Patience is a necessary virtue. Be calm, be restrained, do not allow yourself to be distracted or fooled by your ego. Only then shall the beast of myth be yours." - Hunter's Creed

150.Name: Wild-blood Bravehelm
150.Description: "Strong-willed and decisive in battle, quick to adapt to change without hesitation. Hesitation will only strip us of our honor." - Blood Guard Oath

151.Name: Witchdoctor's Robes
151.Description: "Through the hands of the Spirit of Nature, our curse has become a blessing. The barren wastes grant us strength, the harshness and cruelty of the land becoming our greatest gift." - The Carved Annals of Plenty

152.Name: Berserker's Primacuirass
152.Description: "Bravery is essential as a hunter. When prey lashes out, you need the confidence to hold your ground, stay calm, and fight to the end." - Hunter's Creed

153.Name: Wild-blood Warplate
153.Description: "The Spirit of Nature granted us strong bodies so that we can enjoy the thrill of battle and the satisfaction of hard-won victory. Here, only the toughest shall survive." - Blood Guard Oath

154.Name: Witchdoctor's Brogans
154.Description: "This miraculous land, borne of nothing appeared to us so suddenly, it gifted us life in dire circumstance. Springs are a blessing, lush plant life is a boon." - The Carved Annals of Plenty

155.Name: Berserker's Windrunners
155.Description: "Speed. Without it, you're no true hunter. Desperate prey may attempt to flee, and it falls to you to outpace them, to ensure they do not escape." - Hunter's Creed

156.Name: Wild-blood Troublestompers
156.Description: "The Spirit of Nature has granted us an unyielding will, to prove that we will always reign victorious. Yet, to choose flight over fight is to choose the truest death sentence." - Blood Guard Oath
